Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. Please find answers inline below and two short attachments: Incident_Comms_Playbook.pdf (sample Major Incident template) and TAM_oncall_schedule.csv (example rota).

1) TAM coverage model
- Dedicated plan: includes a named TAM (primary) and a secondary TAM for coverage. The named TAM is included in the Dedicated contract (no separate license fee). For large commitments we can offer a senior TAM option as part of the SOW.
- Shared TAM: available for Hosted customers; shared across multiple accounts with defined SLOs.

2) Escalation path and SLAs (typical for EMEA customers)
- P1 (production outage impacting live traffic): initial acknowledgement via pager/phone within 15 minutes (10 minutes for Dedicated with named TAM). Target mitigation window 2 hours (90 minutes targeted for Dedicated with named TAM + burst capacity).
- P2 (degraded functionality): acknowledgement within 2 hours; mitigation target 24 hours.
- Escalation matrix (example):
  - Customer TAM (Primary): Name/Contact (for contract we will share direct phone/pager)
  - Support Engineering (on-call): support-oncall@redwood-inference.com / Pager (tier 1)
  - Senior Reliability Eng (escalation): sr-reliability@redwood-inference.com
  - CTO on-call (exec escalation): redwood-cto-oncall@redwood-inference.com (used only for extended incidents)

3) 24x7 on-call and handover
- We operate 24x7 support engineering on-call globally. The customer-facing TAM rotates per agreement — for Dedicated customers the named TAM coordinates handovers and ensures there is always a secondary on-call shadow. Weekly handover notes are posted to the customer Drive folder and summarized in the Monday ops digest.

4) Major Incident comms cadence (sample timeline in attached playbook)
- Initial notification: within 15 minutes of triage (email + SMS/pager + short status post).
- Interim updates: every 30–60 minutes (frequency depends on severity).
- War room: initiated for P1 incidents and includes TAM, support on-call, SRE, and customer ops as appropriate.
- RCA: initial RCA draft within 72 hours; final RCA within 10 business days. Executive RCA available on request (timeline depends on scope).

5) Audit artifacts & evidence
- We can provide SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) under NDA, incident logs (redacted), alerting traces for specific incidents, and retention policy details. Marissa will follow up with the exact artifact list and any NDA steps required.

Next steps
- Proposed slot for a 30-minute technical handoff/validation call: Mon Nov 9 at 10:00 or 15:00 CET. Let us know which works.

Attachments: Incident_Comms_Playbook.pdf (pdf, 95KB); TAM_oncall_schedule.csv (csv, 3KB)

Thanks — happy to jump on the call to walk through the playbook live.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer (Support & Escalations)
Redwood Inference
